text:
Priya: Thanks for the all-hands walkthrough — dropping questions here so infra/product can follow up.
Priya: Main concerns: H100 availability timeline per region, autoscaler warm/cold behavior for bursty workloads, and how Dedicated burst pools will be billed.
Mark: Quick answers: timeline is staged — US-East pilot late June, EU pilot mid-July, APAC limited trial late Aug. All dates subject to supply.
Luis: Will Hosted customers be migrated automatically to H100 instances?
Mark: Hosted: we'll route latency-sensitive endpoints to H100 by default when capacity is available; customers can opt-out. Dedicated remains customer-configurable.
Dina: For short 10-20s spikes we saw long cold-starts. Any runtime fixes?
Mark: We're adding a transient warm pool + "quick-reserve" path that keeps lightweight init artifacts alive for ~45s to avoid full model load. Config coming next week.
Priya: Can you share the proposed autoscaler knobs?
Mark: Example snippet:
```yaml
scaler:
  baseline_replicas: 3
  max_replicas: 200
  warm_pool_enabled: true
  warm_pool_size_pct: 15
  transient_ttl: 45s
```
Mark: `kubectl` we used to surface warm pods:
```bash
kubectl -n redwood get pods -l runtime=warm -o wide
```
ops-bot: New doc uploaded: https://redwood.internal/docs/infra/h100-rollout (internal).
Luis: How will fallbacks be prioritized? Cheaper first or lower-latency first?
Mark: Policy is tiered: customer preference -> latency-sensitive route -> cost-aware fallback. We'll expose a "preference profile" in Console.
Dina: Billing question: Dedicated burst pool — is it metered by peak or consumed minutes?
Priya: Heard from billing: burst will be charged by consumed minutes at a premium multiplier; committed baseline billed as reserved. Final terms in draft SLA.
Priya: Requesting a small Console badge that shows regional capacity hints (green/yellow/red) so SREs can route traffic.
Mark: Console team flagged that; Console-beta for region status + API flag to prefer region targeted for Q2 end.
Luis: Any postmortem or logs from the spike last week?
Mark: I'll drop traces in #eng-infra and attach a short incident note.
Priya: Can we get a short summary/action list?
Dina: Actions: 1) Publish per-region H100 ETA (Mark); 2) Autoscaler config + docs (Mark); 3) Draft Dedicated burst SLO and billing terms (Billing/Priya); 4) Console regional capacity hint mock (Console team). I'll pin this and follow up Friday.
Priya: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
console-bot: Console deploy v3.8 succeeded in us-east at 2175000200.
Priya: If no objections, closing thread. Follow-ups in #eng-infra for tech deep dives.
